01.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule and edit the from option using zones any,DMZ,WAN,WLAN,X0,LAN
01.title: access-rule from
01.result: verify access rule form is successfully edited without error.

02.steps: 1 in CLI type "show access-rule ipv4 uuid xxxxxxxx"
02.title: access-rule ipv4 uuid
02.result: access rule with uuid 4 will show up in console, verify the access rule info is correct

03.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 type "access-rule restore-defaults" and enter "yes"
03.title: access-rule restore-defaults
03.result: CLI returns "Firewall Access Rule defaults restored", and the manully added access rule "access-rule from LAN to WAN action deny source address host 192.168.168.10 destination address host 10.10.10.10" is deleted.

04.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 type "access-rule from LAN to WAN action deny source address host 192.168.168.10 destination address host 10.10.10.10"
3 type "action discard"
4 type "users excluded administrator"
5 type "flow-reporting"
6 type "packet-monitoring"
7 type "commit"
04.title: Modify access-rule
04.result: All the changed should be successfully apply.

05.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule and edit the to option using zones any,DMZ,WAN,WLAN
05.title: access-rule to
05.result: verify access rule is successfully edited without error

06.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule and edit the flow priority option to 42
06.title: access-rule priority
06.result: verify access rule priority is successfully modified.

07.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule and edit the source option using ranges,network,host
07.title: access-rule source
07.result: Verify the source address is successfully change.

08.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule and edit the destination option using ranges,network,host
08.title: access-rule destination
08.result: Verify the destination address is successfully change.

09.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule and edit the service option using SSH,Telnet,HTTP
09.title: access-rule dst service
09.result: Verify the dst service is successfully change.

10.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule and edit the action option using allow,discard,deny
10.title: access-rule action
10.result: Verify access rule action is successfully changed

11.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule and edit the user option use include and exclude guests,administrator,group Everyone
11.title: access-rule user
11.result: Verify access rule action is successfully changed

13.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule and edit the flow report option to enable
13.title: access-rule flow report
13.result: Verify flow-reporting is enable for access rule

15.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule and edit the botnet filter option to enable
15.title: access-rule botnet filter
15.result: Verify botnet-filter is enable for access rule

16.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule and edit the packet monitor option to enable
16.title: access-rule packet monitor
16.result: Verify comment is added for access rule

17.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule with the comment option to AutoACLCLITest
17.title: access-rule comment
17.result: Verify comment is added for access rule

18.steps:
1 enter configure mode in CLI
2 add a access rule and edit the enable option to no enable and enable
18.title: access-rule enable
18.result: verify access rule is successfully enabled
